threads.title: VAM-VAE project commissioning and ramp up

history.quote: Today, worldwide, there are very limited players who are making VAM-VAE, and for us, it is a signature project and we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year.

synthesis.headline: Management delivers on EBITDA margin guidance, while volume and project goals remain unverifiable.

points.text: Management maintains EBITDA and PBDIT margin guidance on track, posting an actual 18.16% EBITDA margin for FY27 so far.
Volume growth guidance is unverifiable with no reported numbers to check against.
VAM-VAE project commissioning and ramp up remains unverifiable as a qualitative promise.
Annual revenue reached 35584.0 crore for Mar 2026 with an operating margin of 18.8%.

bull.text: Annual PAT recovered to 4395.0 crore for Mar 2026 from 3710.0 crore in Mar 2025.
Cash from operations grew to 7088.0 crore for Mar 2026.

bear.text: Quarterly margin dropped to 15.6% in Sep 2026.
